name: Agent swarm for building apps with small local models

mentions.name: Agent swarm for building apps with small local models
mentions.description: This project is a structured agent swarm that autonomously builds apps using small local models. It focuses on scoping tasks appropriately for smaller models, since big models can navigate large scope but smaller ones need more scoping — an under-developed dimension of agentic systems.
mentions.problem: Smaller local models need more scoping than big models to handle large app-building tasks, and this is an under-developed dimension of agentic systems.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building a structured agent swarm to autonomously build apps using small local models.
